answer: Mechanism: self-financed jury pools. Every answer posts a micro-entry fee that seeds that epoch's jury payroll; judges are paid only from what entrants contribute, never from emissions. A sybil fleet must fund the very juries it plans to corrupt, so attack cost grows in lockstep with attempted winnings; a hundred shells fatten the payroll a hundredfold while splitting the prize. The tundra thaws only by contributions, never by printing; each knoll of influence is paid for by its own shadow. Honest entrants pay one small fee and face a delta branching toward proving worth, not renting verdicts.
